fields.v: Yes (1): 'Threats, scalability, generalizability' paragraph names N=1, single developer overlapping with the authors, single platform and domain, individual-skill, post-hoc, survivorship and Hawthorne risks, single-rater regex and descriptive proxies, plus a disconfirmation criterion; short but covers the main threats
fields.quote: Threats, scalability, generalizability. N=1, single developer, single platform (Claude Code), single domain: individual-skill, post-hoc, survivorship, Hawthorne risks apply; maintenance-class is single-rater regex; line counts are descriptive proxies.
fields.why: The threats paragraph is short but explicit and covers several threat types, so Partly may understate it, especially as a similar brief section in record 800486641 was scored Yes.
fields.doubt: O parágrafo de ameaças é curto mas explícito (N=1, autor-programador, viés post-hoc, sobrevivência, Hawthorne, um só avaliador). No registo 800486641 uma secção breve teve Sim. Lê a pág. 4 e decide Q10: Parcial (0,5) ou Sim (1), de forma coerente.
